newsitem.title: USA: American says 97 pct of Hard Suits tendered.
newsitem.headline: American says 97 pct of Hard Suits tendered.

text.p: American Oilfield Divers Inc said Friday that a total of 9,616,594 common shares, or about 97 percent of the common shares outstanding of Hard Suits Inc, have been taken up and paid for under American's offer dated September 25, 1996, which expired on November 8, 1996.
American also announced that Rene (Phil) Nuytten and William Liddell, previously the president and chief executive and secretary/treasurer of Hard Suits, respectively, have both left the company.

American Oilfield Divers provides diving services, subsea products, marine construction and environmental services to the offshore oil and gas industry, primarily in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, U.S. West Coast, internationally and to certain U.S. inland customers.
